verdict.rationale: monday.com documents a GraphQL API with SDKs and an OpenAPI spec for automating workflows without the UI. It also states agents can be run and managed programmatically from your own code "anywhere you need it", and offers managed cron, queues, logs and a developer MCP for scaffolding, env vars and version promotion. Together these support headless, scripted operation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration (e.g. CLI or pipeline actions), documented headless auth patterns for CI runners, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
